name: Ample pc-Minimal Periphery-Free Partial Cubes
definition: The finite ample partial cubes $O$ with no peripheral coordinate for which every proper pc-minor has a peripheral coordinate in every nontrivial pc-minor, equivalently every proper pc-minor belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$.
canonical_form: Members are considered up to cube isomorphism. Together with the antipodally punctured hypercubes, these are all pc-minimal obstructions to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$.
recognition: For an irredundant family on $X$, inspect every feasible state $\tau:X\to\{\mathsf K,\mathsf C,0,1\}$. The original state must be periphery-free and every other nontrivial state must expose a peripheral coordinate. Equivalently, at any chosen outer coordinate, the two layers and their union belong to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$, while the all-retained layer state is the unique state in which every displayed coordinate retains defects in both orientations. The latter condition is computable from the minimal repair antichains. A direct implementation uses at most $4^{|X|}$ states.
comments: This family is exact but not reduced to a finite list. It includes the pentagonal obstruction and several infinite explicit subfamilies retained in the source paper.
